Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing free flights for state officers and employees under certain circumstances.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to certain flights by state officers and stateemployees; and adding a new section to chapter 42.52 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: State officers and state employees may fly with flight instructorsconducting training flights to airports not served by regularcommercial air service, as such activity by state officers and stateemployees is presumed to be within the scope of their duties and not tobe in violation of the solicitation and receipt of gift provisions inRCW 42.52.140 and 42.52.150.
